launch.description: Real Taoglas EMPCB.SMAFSTJ.B.HT SMA + impedance-matched CPWG launch (gap 0.2512mm, ground inner edge 0.8512mm, feed 1.2mm, 6 stitch vias/side, solved 50.00 ohm) -- topologies/cascade.py TAOGLAS_SMA, the actual default for every cascade mesh since 2026-08-31.

shape_check.note: FINE CONFIRM (evaluate, different mesh preset) measured s11w=-14.92dB, bw=188MHz, shape 3 zeros/3 peaks (want 3/2) -- not yet a clean equiripple response

known_open_item: NOT landed -- S11w -13.4 to -14.9dB vs the -16dB spec, bw ~188-189MHz vs the 143.5MHz target. Genuine local optimum: two independent local GP search rounds (span=2mm then span=1mm, patience=16 each) converged here, starting from the calibrate-and-invert pipelines fc-trimmed + mid-trimmed design. Best N=3 result this session.

pec_regression_check.why: Re-ran the golden's own reproduce_with sweep after porting the real-metal exterior-face split into palace_driven and after fixing the board outline in siw_geometry. Confirms neither touched the PEC path.
pec_regression_check.verdict: reproduces the metrics block to every digit

real_copper.model: Boundaries.Conductivity surface impedance on the EXTERIOR ground planes only (170 of 176 PEC faces split out; internal via barrels and the trace stay PEC because that BC is exterior-only). sigma = 5.96e7 S/m, 17.5 um.
real_copper.command: siw compare-fab-variants --run --topology cascade --N 3 --params l_cav1=34.239,l_cav2=35.503,w_iris=14.416,w_ext=13.96,l_taper=15.738,w_ms=1.6636 --device CPU --np 4 --result-json output/data/fab_variants_cascade_N3.json --out-name fab_variant_comparison_cascade_N3
real_copper.note: The PEC reference here is the FINE-CONFIRM preset (-14.92 dB), not the sweep preset in `metrics` (-13.37 dB) -- the same preset difference already recorded in shape_check. Compare copper against the PEC cell of the SAME run, never across presets. Cost is 0.59 dB of insertion loss, nearly double the dual-mode board's 0.32 dB, which is expected: three cavities and 47 mm more wall. Shape is unchanged (3 zeros, 1 lobe).
real_copper.not_modelled: Soldermask, silkscreen and ENIG. All are unresolvable at this mesh density (damage scales with layer THINNESS -- the signature of sliver elements) and the board is being ordered bare in any case. ENIG is additionally an RF no-op here: it plates the OUTER face of the ground planes, ~14 skin depths from the current.
